import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();
        int[] flags = new int[100];
        char[] sChars = s.toCharArray();

        for (int i = 1; i + 1 < sChars.length; ++i) {
            if (i + 1 < sChars.length && s.substring(i, i + 2).equals("at")) {
                sChars[i] = '@';
                flags[i + 1] = 1;
                break;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i + 2 < sChars.length; ++i) {
            if (i + 2 < sChars.length && s.substring(i, i + 3).equals("dot")) {
                sChars[i] = '.';
                flags[i + 1] = 1;
                flags[i + 2] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sChars.length; ++i) {
            if (flags[i] == 0) {
                System.out.print(sChars[i]);
            }
        }
        System.out.println();
        scanner.close();
    }
}
